profiles.name: generic
profiles.description: Gerber X2 with six decimals, Excellon with a decimal point, slots as round holes, the rotation of a bottom part unchanged, CSV files with the columns of the board

profiles.name: jlc-like
profiles.description: Shaped after the files that low-cost assemblers ask for: coordinates from the lower left corner of the board, Top and Bottom for the sides, a half turn added to the rotation of a bottom part, the headers Designator, Val, Package, Mid X, Mid Y, Rotation, Layer. Not compared with any manufacturer

profiles.name: x2-full
profiles.description: The generic profile with every Gerber X2 attribute: the file attributes (function, polarity, project, coordinate system, part), the function of each aperture and of each drill tool, and the net, the pin and the component of each object. Not opened in any manufacturer viewer

profiles.name: x1
profiles.description: The generic profile as plain Gerber X1: no attribute of any kind in the layer files and no attribute comment in the drill files
